Concert on Liberation War at Army Stadium on March 7
2016-02-29T03:11:54+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/concert-liberation-war-army-stadium-march-7-783985

The Centre for Research and Information (CRI) will hold "Joy Bangla Concert" on March 7 to rekindle the spirit of the 1971 Liberation War in light of the historic speech of March 7 by Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

Apart from presenting the historic speech in a giant screen, seven leading bands will render patriotic songs at the six-hour concert, which will start at 4:00pm at the capital's Army Stadium, said a press release.

Interested persons are requested to register at http://ticket.youngbangla.org to get free tickets, Tonmoy Ahmed, assistant coordinator of the CRI, told The Daily Star.
